objective: Compose an already-verified and already-normalized Telnyx voice event with the landed D1 correlated-event application and the landed webhook acknowledgement policy.
execution: Construct the landed D1 correlated-event application from the caller-provided database.
Apply the canonical TelnyxVoiceEvent exactly once per invocation.
Map the exact ApplyTelnyxCorrelatedEventResult through the landed F3 acknowledgement policy.
Return both domain application evidence and transport-neutral acknowledgement policy.
invariants: The D1 application service is composed once when the F4 service is created.
No D1 query occurs merely from constructing the F4 service.
Each apply invocation delegates exactly once to the landed D1 application.
F4 does not duplicate provider-event receipt persistence.
F4 does not reinterpret D3 application outcomes.
F4 does not reinterpret F3 acknowledgement policy.
